pieces.Text: The teachings of your deity help you keep your secrets safe.
Once per day when you create a glamer or figment effect, you can empower the effect so that the DC to disbelieve it is 2 higher than normal.

Situational.text: Prerequisites: Caster level 3rd, ability to cast at least one glamer or figment, worshiper of Sivanah.
